name: Core of Elements
label: Quest
description: Core of Elements: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Truth be told, I use the cores to create Frostfire armor. It is the armor used by the mages battling in Naxxramas. Without you and others like you, we would most definitely be losing this war.
With that said, bring me more cores and I shall grant you more insignias.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You perform a great service for us, friend. Well done!
